title: Knowledge Record Release Policy
description: Machine-readable release gates for Knowledge Records. Complements RELEASE_POLICY.md. Specification only.

gates.name: Reviews complete
gates.requirement: academic_review, technical_review, and governance_review are approved or explicitly waived per policy.

gates.name: Freeze bound
gates.requirement: freeze.status MUST be frozen before release_status=released.

gates.name: Quality threshold
gates.requirement: Overall quality score >= 80; blocking metrics Traceability, Bibliography Integrity, Governance Compliance pass.

gates.name: Schema and indexes
gates.requirement: Record indexed in record_index; IDs valid; no invented SRC-* citations.

gates.name: Changelog
gates.requirement: Release notes / changelog entry exists for the version being published.

gates.name: No TODO_REVIEW on high-confidence claims
gates.requirement: Assertions with confidence=high MUST NOT remain TODO_REVIEW.

package_contents: Knowledge Record artifact (markdown and/or compiled JSON)
post_release: Set identity.status and release.release_status to official/released
Notify consumers of ID or semantic changes
Retain prior versions per version policy
